searchText: How would other editors feel about having one of the bots replace the PR description with a standardized template? A lot of authors seem to keep the template text, which is kinda annoying. I wouldn't mind seeing the `discussions-to` link and maybe a few other summary items. <@!543900561460822016> https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4417 <- safe to approve? Do we have to wait for the author? generally we don't merge these types of requests w/o approval from the author And if the author doesn't reply? then the change doesn't usually get merged
